Fixes for the mouse, small windows and Tailscale.

- **The mouse pointer shows again.** It was hidden all the time; it now appears when you use the mouse (including over Parsec) and hides when you pick up the controller.
- **Small windows fit:** the clock and status icons stay visible, tabs tighten or scroll, and the banner no longer cuts its description in half.
- **Tailscale is found wherever it's installed** (its service, the Start menu app, PATH). Settings › System › Tailscale shows where Lounge found it, or where it looked.
